label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_first_01
text: Rika here, at your service! Glad to be workin’\nwith ya![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp01_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I’m not gonna lie,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
Didn’t
expect
I’d
be
getting
this
invite
from you![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp01_01
text: Just couldn’t get enough of ol’ Rika, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp01_select_01
text: Exactly!

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp01_select_02
text: I guess...?

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp01_03
text: Nice! It’s good to be honest! I don’t mind the\nattention, either.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp01_03b
text: You guess?! C’mon, be a bit more enthusiastic\nfor me![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp01_04
text: Anyway, let’s get down to business—you want me\nto bring some liveliness to the academy, right?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp01_05
text: Nobody’s better at livening up a place than ol’\nRika! You just leave this to me![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp02_00
text: Last time I was here, I was basically babysittin’\nthe boss.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp02_01
text: She may seem all professional and perfectly put\ntogether, but she can be super absent-minded\r\nsometimes. Someone’s gotta look after her.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp02_select_01
text: I wouldn’t have guessed!

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp02_select_02
text: You make a good team!

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp02_02
text: It’s true! Even that Indigo Disk thing—the boss\ncompletely spaced on giving it to Briar![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp02_02b
text: You got that right! I mean, it figures—we’ve been\nworking together a long time.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp02_03
text: But yeah, she definitely needs a hand. I’ve\neven caught her—more than once—showing up\r\nto work with Glimmet tangled up in her hair.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp02_04
text: Oh, uh...don’t tell the boss I told you that, yeah?\nShe’d give me the scolding of a lifetime...[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp02_05
text: Let’s keep it between you an’ me, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp03_00
text: It’s fun teaching the students here, but I’ll be\nhonest—all the thinking’s tiring sometimes![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp03_01
text: I gotta switch to, like, my professional mode,\ny’know? It’s exhausting.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp03_02
text: Slap on those glasses to look all sharp and\neverything. They’re just for show, to be honest.\r\nI don’t need ’em to see.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp03_03
text: You saw me in professional mode, right? For the\ninterview thing?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp03_04
text: Which do you prefer? Professional-mode Rika, or\nRika as-is?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp03_select_01
text: Rika as-is!

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp03_select_02
text: Professional-mode Rika!

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp03_05
text: Oooh, that so? Then when I’m around you, I’ll\nloosen up as much as I can and just be myself![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp03_05b
text:
Oooh, is that so?!\c
In that case, perhaps you’d prefer I interact with
you in a more polite, refined manner?\c
Heh! Gotcha.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_sp03_06
text: Anyhoo, I’ll keep what you said in mind![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_trade_01_00
text: Hey—we’re talkin’ an awful lot these days, aren’t\nwe?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_trade_01_01
text: I feel like we’re gettin’ to know each other pretty\nwell. Why don’t we do something to celebrate?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_trade_01_02
text: Oh, I know! Why don’t we trade Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_trade_01_03
text: Great! That settles it, then. Now, ol’ Rika’s gonna\nput up a Wooper to trade! Whatcha got for me?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_trade_03_01

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_battleend_win_00_01

label: coach_paldea4kings_zimen_battleend_win_00_02
